jobs.title: Director of Ethics, Governance & Organizational Strategy
jobs.description:
Director of Ethics, Governance & Organizational Strategy

AARUNI Inc. · Toronto, Ontario, Canada · Hybrid · Full-time

About the Opportunity
AARUNI Inc. is a Canadian advisory firm focused on ethical leadership, corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and organizational accountability. We help organizations strengthen decision-making, improve governance practices, and address complex ethical and operational challenges.
We are seeking a Director of Ethics, Governance & Organizational Strategy to contribute to the development of our advisory practice, advance strategic initiatives, cultivate professional relationships, and support the firm's long-term growth.

Key Responsibilities
Contribute to the development and execution of organizational strategy and business priorities.
Research emerging developments in business ethics, corporate governance, compliance, and organizational accountability.
Develop recommendations and advisory approaches addressing ethical risks and governance challenges.
Support the creation and refinement of policies, internal controls, governance frameworks, and operating standards.
Identify opportunities to expand advisory services and establish relationships with prospective clients and strategic partners.
Evaluate organizational challenges and recommend practical, principled approaches to decision-making.
Contribute to business development, service innovation, and the firm's professional positioning.
Exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive matters and confidential business information.

Qualifications & Experience
Strong analytical thinking, strategic judgment, and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent written communication, research, and professional presentation skills.
Demonstrated interest or experience in ethics, corporate governance, compliance, risk management, consulting, or organizational strategy.
Ability to work independently, assess complex situations, and formulate well-reasoned recommendations.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
A bachelor's degree from a recognized, accredited university is required.
A postgraduate qualification in business, governance, law, or a related discipline is an asset but not required.

What AARUNI Offers
An opportunity to contribute to the development of a Canadian ethics advisory firm.
Involvement in strategic planning, advisory services, and organizational development.
A flexible working environment.
Opportunities to contribute ideas, develop professional relationships, and shape the firm's service offerings.

Application Process
Applicants are invited to submit a résumé outlining their qualifications, relevant experience, and suitability for the position.

As part of the application, candidates are kindly requested to include a brief example in their résumé of an ethical dilemma they encountered and how they navigated or resolved it. The example should demonstrate ethical reasoning, sound judgment, and decision-making.

AARUNI Inc. is committed to professional and fair recruitment practices. Applicant information will be handled confidentially and used for recruitment purposes.

Join AARUNI Inc. in advancing ethical leadership, effective governance, and organizational accountability.

Show less

Director

Employment type

Full-time

Industries
